patches.why: Vercel still serves Edge Config item updates at /v1/edge-config/{edgeConfigId}/items, the path the document now names /v1/global-config/{edgeConfigId}/items. This rests on client code, not on Vercel's reference, which documents only the global-config path: Dub updates its Edge Config items at the edge-config path in production.
The edge-config path's PATCH is the global-config path's (the same items body and answer), as Dub's call through it shows (client code, not Vercel's reference).
The copied operation needs its own id beside patchEdgeConfigItems (the twin's name; client code, not Vercel's reference).

The one Global Config the 200 schema types is what each entry of the list is: the operation "Returns all Global Configs." and its 200 is "List of all global configs." (the page), so the list's item schema is kept as a component.
The 200 of Get Global Configs is a list: "Returns all Global Configs.", "List of all global configs." (the page); the document types one config.
